title: buddi catalogue agent (agents/<name>/agent.json)
description: Configuration only: nothing here runs. Unknown fields are refused, by the market check and by buddi. `integrity` and `claims` are written by `node scripts/check.mjs --write agent:<name>`; everything else is written by hand.

name.description: The agent id and its folder name; unique across plugins and agents in the market.

version.description: Semver. Any change to the package moves it, with a `changes` line.

handle.description: The default handle, without the @. buddi picks a free one (chef-2) when it is taken.

pitch.description: The card's one line. No tool names (the check refuses a known one).

description.description: The agent file's description: one line other agents read to hand it work. No tool names.

about.description: Two or three sentences for the detail page. No tool names.

buddi.description: The buddi versions it works with, a semver range.

requires.description: Plugins that must be installed: listed plugin name → semver range.

optional.description: Plugins that make it better. A tool ending in ? belongs to one of these.

needs.description: Requirements that are not plugins. mailbox? is a mailbox that makes it better: its email.* tools then end in ? and hold only while a mailbox is linked.

tools.description: The grant: tool names or family globs, a trailing ? for an optional plugin's. The privilege boundary.

cron.description: Five fields, in the owner's timezone.

reportMax.description: The longest report this mission sends, in characters (buddi 1.27; the default is 1,500).

context.description: An export of a plugin in requires that buddi calls before each run, its answer in the run's first message (buddi 1.27).

fills.description: The picks the install sheet asks, each with a default.

mission.description: kind time only: the mission whose hour it sets.

examples.description: Example asks for the detail page and the done screen. No tool names.

roles.description: Capabilities it answers for (plugin missions and watchers address roles). By-buddi packages only; anything else carries [].

replaces.description: Older agents this package supersedes, as <source>/<id>.

changes.description: One line for this version, in the owner's words: no tool names.
